item.tib: pu ri la brten nas 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin sgrub thabs dus min 'chi ba skyobs mdzad 'dod don lhun grub
item.coloph: ces pu ri la brten nas 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin sgrab thabs 'di ni rig (rigs) sngags 'chang ba dbal khyung bon gter ram bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pas shing mo bya yi lor shod chen gtso bo lhang brag gi nye 'dabs rgya sgo ma gter du drangs te/ lo bcu gsum gsang rgya bsdom (bsdams) te slar yang sa pho khyi lor rang la tshe yi gegs rkyen sel thabs mkha' 'gro lung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ rang bstan bkra shis mthong smon gling du gu drag sgrub pa'i thun 'tshams (mtshams) su shog ser las phab grub bgyis pas/ dge des 'gro kun tshe yi rig 'dzin gyur pa'i rgyu ru shog cig/
